svg.title: Forecasting Agent Workflow — graphics-only editable vector source
svg.desc: Object-level SVG with no raster image and no text objects. Space for titles, captions and labels is intentionally reserved; independent text coordinates are supplied in the companion labels JSON. Curves and residual matrix are schematic, not empirical measurements.
